GitHub 發佈與 Firebase 同步設定

將此 HTML 上傳至 GitHub Pages 後，在兩台裝置開啟同一個 HTTPS 網址，選取相同暱稱與簡短識別碼。本機開檔可使用訪客、錯題本與成績歷史。

Firebase 專案沿用原卷設定。請開啟 Authentication 的匿名登入，將 GitHub Pages 網域加入授權網域，並啟用 Cloud Firestore。此頁面讀取固定文件及各學習者的成績集合，無須複合索引。

此測驗的 Firestore 規則片段

將以下 match 區塊放在現有規則的 documents 範圍內。規則供此共享暱稱教材使用。

match /Exam-Biology-c-1/{root} {
  function signed() { return request.auth != null; }
  function validId(s) { return s is string && s.matches('^[0-9a-f]{32}$'); }
  allow get: if signed() && (root == 'global' || validId(root));
  allow create, update: if signed() && root == 'global'
    && request.resource.data.keys().hasOnly(['learnerIndex'])
    && request.resource.data.learnerIndex is map
    && request.resource.data.learnerIndex.size() <= 1000;
  match /profiles/{id} {
    function shared() { return signed() && root == 'learners' && validId(id); }
    allow get: if shared();
    allow create: if shared() && request.resource.data.learnerId == id
      && request.resource.data.keys().hasOnly(['learnerId','nickname','avatarId','shortCode','createdAt','schemaVersion','legacy'])
      && request.resource.data.nickname is string
      && request.resource.data.nickname.size() > 0 && request.resource.data.nickname.size() <= 20
      && request.resource.data.avatarId in ['🐼','🦊','🐧','🐰','🐯','🐳'];
    match /progress/current {
      function progress() {
        let d = request.resource.data;
        return d.keys().hasOnly(['quizVersion','learnerId','articleTitle','attemptId','practiceType','baseFullAttemptId','retainedCorrectQuestionIds','targets','answers','flags','wrongBook','startedAtClient','updatedAt','completedAtClient','revision','resetEpoch'])
          && d.quizVersion == 'biology-c1-112' && d.learnerId == id && validId(d.attemptId)
          && d.practiceType in ['full','wrong_only'] && d.revision is int
          && d.answers is map && d.answers.size() <= 50 && d.flags is map && d.flags.size() <= 50
          && d.wrongBook is map && d.wrongBook.size() <= 50
          && d.targets is list && d.targets.size() > 0 && d.targets.size() <= 50;
      }
      allow get: if shared();
      allow create: if shared() && progress() && request.resource.data.revision == 1;
      allow update: if shared() && progress() && request.resource.data.revision == resource.data.revision + 1;
    }
    match /attempts/{aid} {
      allow read: if shared();
      allow create: if shared() && validId(aid) && request.resource.data.attemptId == aid
        && request.resource.data.keys().hasOnly(['articleTitle','quizVersion','learnerId','nicknameSnapshot','attemptId','startedAtClient','completedAtClient','totalQuestions','correctCount','wrongCount','score','practiceType','baseFullAttemptId','recordedAtServer'])
        && request.resource.data.learnerId == id && request.resource.data.quizVersion == 'biology-c1-112'
        && request.resource.data.practiceType in ['full','wrong_only']
        && request.resource.data.totalQuestions > 0 && request.resource.data.totalQuestions <= 50
        && request.resource.data.correctCount >= 0 && request.resource.data.wrongCount >= 0
        && request.resource.data.correctCount + request.resource.data.wrongCount == request.resource.data.totalQuestions
        && request.resource.data.score >= 0 && request.resource.data.score <= 100;
    }
  }
}
